stages.goal: reproduce stock K1 walk, kick and stand-up separately; freeze tensor and motor contract
identify measured actuator/sensor/latency distributions; improve recurrent or history-based state estimation
train robustness curriculum; hold out combined disturbances and robot identities
retarget T1 reactive soccer skill training to K1; keep B-Human behavior and rule handling
train high-level decentralized cooperation with centralized critics and historical opponent pools
validate identical model/config/service semantics across isolated virtual robots and hardware

proposed_validation.denominator: all pre-registered trials, including missing or failed executions
proposed_validation.note: All target thresholds and disturbance ranges must be set from measured K1 limits and a frozen baseline. This plan does not claim stability outside a defined distribution.
